sn56.22:3.1: Idam avoca Bhagavā || pe || etad avoca satthā || ||
sn56.22:4.1: Ye dukkhaṃ nappajānanti || atho dukkhassa sambhavaṃ || Yattha ca sabbaso dukkhaṃ || asesam uparujjhati ||||
sn56.22:5.1: Tañca maggaṃ na jānanti || dukkhūpasamagāminaṃ || Cetovimuttihīnā te || atho paññāvimuttiyā || Abhabbā te antakiriyāya || te ve jātijarūpagā ||||
sn56.22:6.1: Ye ca dukkham pajānanti || atho dukkhassa sambhavaṃ || Yattha ca sabbaso dukkhaṃ || asesaṃ uparujjhati ||||
sn56.22:7.1: Tañca maggam pajānanti || dukkhūpasamagāminaṃ || Ceto vimuttisampannā || atho paññāvimuttiyā || Bhabbā te antakiriyāya || na te jātijarūpagā ti ||||
